$comment: Dynamic-field UI contract for the Contoso Projects fixture connector, as dynamicFieldUiContracts() produces it. A renderer needs nothing else: `field` says which input to decorate, `dependsOn` says which other inputs must be filled first (and therefore when to re-run the lookup), `constants` are inputs the lookup always sends, `selection` says where the option value and title live in the response, and `operationRef` is the approved bound operation the host calls. Values are fetched server-side through the adapter; a renderer never calls the provider itself. Only the preferred form of a field appears, so a field that declares both the older and the newer Power Platform extension is rendered once.
